amendment_from_1_0.trigger: The parent causality audit was strengthened from protocol 1 to protocol 2 by checking the literal frozen rule clause in every target public span.
amendment_from_1_0.scope: Update the parent provenance only. Required metrics, mutations, interpretations, thresholds and all observed sensitivity results are unchanged.
amendment_from_1_0.timing: The metric sensitivity results were already known, so this amendment is not represented as a preregistration; it makes no result-dependent scoring change.

reason_for_addendum: The preregistered all-content-edge omission mutation leaves overall typed-edge micro F1 at 0.938960 while content-dependency F1 and factual-plus-complete-chain exact both fall to zero. Content-edge opportunity also varies from 1.6 to 4.8 mean edges per question across levels, so overall edge F1 and content exact-by-level are not sufficient measurements of the new ability.
interpretation_rules: Overall typed-edge micro F1 must never be used alone to claim content-dependency ability.
Content-dependency exact-by-level is opportunity-sensitive and cannot by itself establish the five-level difficulty ordering.
Field-macro and scenario-macro F1 must accompany micro and question-macro F1 so the frequent no_ball_called family cannot dominate the result.
Endpoint recovery and conditional-link F1 are error decompositions, not substitutes for typed-edge or full-chain scores.
The frozen factual primary metric and 45-65% target remain unchanged; these graph metrics measure an additional ability and cannot retroactively redefine factual difficulty.
Static causal certification establishes internal gold consistency, not empirical strong-model difficulty or independent human agreement.

required_mutations.remove_all_content_edges: content F1 and factual-plus-complete-chain exact must be zero
required_mutations.reverse_all_content_edges: content F1 and conditional-link F1 must decrease
required_mutations.change_all_content_relations: content F1 must be zero despite unchanged endpoints
required_mutations.remove_one_content_edge: content recall and strict chain exact must decrease while factual scores remain unchanged
required_mutations.add_one_false_content_edge: content precision and strict chain exact must decrease while content recall remains one
